title: The product bound puts the inverse 2-norm strictly below 319/100 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, the product of the certified inverse 1-norm and infinity-norm upper bounds is strictly below `(319/100)^2`. The inverse 2-norm is therefore strictly below `319/100`, hence strictly below `321`.
- The round ceilings multiply as `(282/100)*(361/100) = 101802/10000`, and `319^2 < 101802 < 320^2`.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is one normalized section, not an all-size inverse bound.
